# TorHoerman Law

> > TorHoerman Law is a personal injury and mass tort law firm specializing in product liability, medical device litigation, auto accidents, and pharmaceutical cases across Illinois and Missouri.

The firm handles complex litigation including transvaginal mesh lawsuits, defective medical devices, auto insurance disputes, and pharmaceutical product liability. TorHoerman Law provides legal resources, case updates, and educational content on FDA regulations, tort reform, and civil litigation procedures.

## Key Topics

- Product Liability
- Medical Device Lawsuits
- Transvaginal Mesh Litigation
- Personal Injury Claims
- Auto Accident Claims
- FDA Approval Process
- Boston Scientific Cases
- C.R. Bard Litigation
- Insurance Claim Denials
- Statute of Limitations
- Tort Reform
- Defense Verdicts
- Pharmaceutical Liability
- Illinois and Missouri Law
- Mass Tort Litigation

## Medical Device & Product Liability

- [Missouri Jury Sides With Defendant In Complicated Transvaginal Mesh Case](https://www.torhoermanlaw.com/missouri-jury-sides-with-defendant-in-complicated-transvaginal-mesh-case): Missouri jury verdict in Boston Scientific transvaginal mesh lawsuit
- [Generic Drugs Vs. Name-Brand Drugs - How Manufacturers Dodge Liability](https://www.torhoermanlaw.com/generic-drugs): FDA approval differences and liability issues for generic vs brand drugs
- [FDA Approval Process And Criticisms](https://www.torhoermanlaw.com/fda-approval-process): FDA drug and medical device approval process with regulatory criticisms

## Auto Accident & Insurance Claims

- [9 Reasons Why Car Insurance Claims Are Denied](https://www.torhoermanlaw.com/9-reasons-why-car-insurance-claims-are-denied): Common reasons for car insurance claim denials and legal advice
- [Choosing Auto Insurance That Will Help In The Event Of A Car Accident](https://www.torhoermanlaw.com/auto-insurance-car-accident): Guide to selecting auto insurance coverage for accident protection
- [Auto Accident News Chicago, Illinois](https://www.torhoermanlaw.com/auto-accident-news-chicago-illinois): Chicago and Illinois auto accident news archive and local reports

## Legal Guides & Procedures

- [Statute Of Limitations: Guide To SOL In Criminal & Civil Litigation](https://www.torhoermanlaw.com/general-guide-statute-limitations): Legal guide to filing deadlines in criminal and civil litigation cases
- [Myth Of Tort Reform - Stripping Civil Rights In Favor Of Corporate Profit](https://www.torhoermanlaw.com/myth-tort-reform-stripping-away-civil-rights-favor-corporate-profit): Tort reform debate and impact on civil rights and corporate accountability
